findings.summary: Better Auth test defaults skipped Origin checks, leaving a verification gap. No production bypass established.
findings.resolution: Explicit native CSRF/Origin flags plus exact browser-write Origin/Fetch Metadata bridge gate; independent review and all negative HTTP cases passed at d43d78571a36e709b487e969d6d81485f401c294.

findings.summary: Test expected standard Retry-After while native limiter emits X-Retry-After.
findings.resolution: Preserve native header and normalize numeric delay to standard header. Actual socket-IP rate-limit HTTP test passed despite forged forwarding headers.

findings.summary: Original cookie test assumed ordinary uncached login generated multiple cookies.
findings.resolution: Exercise actual rememberMe:false HTTP flow; verify distinct session/dont_remember HttpOnly cookies and authenticated access. Independent source review and real PostgreSQL CI passed.
